positions.title: Student Software Developer and Tester
positions.description:
•	Built frontend web components using Angular
•	Developed end-to-end tests to verify software requirements for U.S. Military are met
•	Improved manual test coverage by implementing Gherkin tests
•	Utilized Protractor automated testing to comprehensively test the user interface

positions.title: Application Developer
positions.description:
•	Designed and developed a client-facing, mobile-friendly web application using Adobe XD and React.js to facilitate and promote social distancing on public transit
•	Deployed company website with a custom domain and subdomains using AWS Route 53

positions.title: Technology Summer Analyst
positions.description:
•	Created an interactive Data Quality Dashboard using Angular to monitor the integrity of data being fed downstream to clients
•	Implemented drill down functionality on dashboard for effective reporting across several levels of management

positions.title: Undergraduate Researcher - FIDO Lab
positions.description:
• Project Lead for Instrumented Dog Leash Project
• Created a flexible leash with integrated sensors to measure aggression and rehabilitation potential in shelter dogs
• Used Arduino to write data from accelerometer, real time clock, and stretch sensor to an SD card

positions.title: Technical Product Management Intern
positions.description:
•	Created auto-updating “actual vs projected” report for resource allocation to improve employee efficiency
•	Optimized the team’s project intake process by designing online forms to more efficiently gather and understand requirements for software to be developed
•	Implemented customizable interactive RACIs for the end-to-end intake process
•	Aided in the promotion of the Agile methodology in ITS Global through proper documentation

projects.title: Instrumented Leash
projects.description: Project leader of an initiative to create an instrumented dog leash that incorporates a 9-axis accelerometer, a real time clock, LED indicator lights, and a stretch sensor. All of the components are integrated with a Feather M0 microcontroller.

projects.title: The Parthenon in Augmented Reality
projects.description: Collaborating as part of the development team that is working to build out the Acropolis in virtual, augmented, and mixed reality using A-Frame.
